notes.title: New Girls Love Visual Novel Released!
notes.content:
It's been almost a year exactly since we released Alice in Stardom. While it might get lost going from platform to platform, the fact remains that Alice in Stardom was our NaNoRenO visual novel we made last year with a small team completely for free in just a month. Thank you all for checking out our game jam project! The response blew us away, and we're still grateful.

This year, we decided to make a bigger project for the game jam- it's mainly an otome, but still has one girls love route (2 male routes, 1 female route). Returning this year was the art lead from Alice in Stardom, Violora. She helped direct the artists for this new project, Enamored Risks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34747387/44c65a12fdada90d428f0a2f4e024d52b82c3985.png[/img]

The game is about Alex, a lonely college student who just wants a break from it all, when one day she stumbles upon a mysterious social media account. She ends up meeting a group of urban explorers and starts going on mini-adventures with them- and possibly falling in love with one.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34747387/3de2d801f51bc31a303aa8d67290db01d9b781ff.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34747387/97b3d1f25e058280538f094f931db0a17ce8a9ad.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34747387/8a43f39b65cfbe540a9e7d76fb260fd66e8b64e6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34747387/1ffa417e5b446ff848ed0069a1195d01179e7755.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34747387/e93ef36ebf48e73d9840068f666873b3ec7307c1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34747387/63ee4b01134a59959a8d401cd298fd54dd754574.png[/img][/url]

The project is now finished and released on Steam (as well as Itchio and Google Play)! If you guys want to play another game with a girls love route in it with the same heart as Alice in Stardom, then please check out Enamored Risks.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1274200/Enamored_Risks/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34747387/7a7cf17b22645d0b65b3ec91112fe72ff4ffb689.png[/img]

notes.title: Fixes + Art Contest!
notes.content:
Hey guys! Just going to start off by saying THANK YOU ALL SO MUCH!
Our team made Alice in Stardom in just around a month for the NaNoRenO visual novel jam and we've been floored by the amount of love and support for the project. So, thank you all so much for checking it out!

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

Second, we've [b]implemented a few much-needed fixes[/b] and plan to have a few more out soon. A few of the fixes we've made include a few proofreading mistakes and the "flickering" Alice's sprite does when it's outfit change time.

[h1]Art Contest[/h1]

Third... we're having an [b]art contest for Alice in Stardom[/b]! You can win multiple prizes for drawing any of the AiS characters! For more info, check out either of these two pages:
[list]
[*] [url=https://crystalgameworks.weebly.com/news/alice-in-stardom-art-contest]Blog Entry[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.deviantart.com/mikomikisomi/journal/Alice-in-Stardom-Art-Contest-Ends-October-4th-811190600]deviantART Journal[/url]
[/list]

[b]Feel free to submit your entry in our [url=https://discord.gg/vE2Yng4]Discord server[/url] or on [url=https://twitter.com/CrystalGameWork]Twitter[/url]![/b] 

[h1]Thank you guys![/h1]
